sequential_dependency.intermediate: The input-dependent primitive stencil height and width, distinct from the raw quadrant dimensions.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Recover the smallest exact row and column repeat periods of the transparent stencil.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Use the primitive periods to partition output into stencil copies and address the backing color for each copy, reversing odd backing rows in snake mode.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The same transparent output cell addresses a different backing cell when the intermediate period is wrong. The counterfactual keeps the tiled stencil pixels and output dimensions unchanged but uses raw quadrant dimensions for addressing.
